description: Several small plastic cups are lined up on the table in front—green, red, blue, and yellow—with a yellow squeeze bottle nearby and a blue scrub pad in front. The left hand holds the yellow cup while the right hand presses the blue scrub pad against it, rubbing and rotating around the cup’s side and rim; then the left hand places the cleaned yellow cup down in line, and the right hand releases the scrub pad and reaches toward the yellow bottle as the left hand steadies the green cup.
